name: BAT
recent: BAT Malaysia 公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，营收 3.02 亿令吉，净利 230 万令吉，同比大幅下滑；同时宣布第三次中期股息每股 2 仙。公司也披露马来西亚超过一半的卷烟消费涉及逃税。
notable: 宣布第三次中期股息每股 2 仙，总额 RM5,710,600，除息日 2026 年 11 月 30 日，派发日 2026 年 12 月 28 日。
发布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，营收 3.02 亿令吉，净利 230 万令吉。
公司指出马来西亚超过一半的卷烟消费为逃税烟。
risks: 第三季度净利同比下滑 95.4%，环比下滑 77.9%。
营收同比下滑 51.7%，环比下滑 41.4%。
公司披露马来西亚超过一半卷烟消费逃税，影响合法市场销量。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季度营收 3.02 亿令吉，同比下滑 51.7%，环比下滑 41.4%；净利 230 万令吉，同比下滑 95.4%，环比下滑 77.9%；净利率 0.8%，低于上一季度的 2.1%。

recent_en: BAT Malaysia reported 3Q FY2026 revenue of RM302 million and net profit of RM2.3 million, down sharply year-on-year, and declared a third interim dividend of 2 sen per share. It also disclosed that over half of cigarettes consumed in Malaysia evade tax.
notable_en: Declared a third interim dividend of 2 sen per share, totalling RM5,710,600, with ex-date 30 Nov 2026 and payment date 28 Dec 2026.
Released 3Q FY2026 results with revenue of RM302 million and net profit of RM2.3 million.
Company stated that over half of cigarettes consumed in Malaysia are illicit.
risks_en: 3Q net profit fell 95.4% year-on-year and 77.9% quarter-on-quarter.
Company disclosed that over half of cigarettes consumed in Malaysia evade tax, affecting legal market volumes.
earnings_en: 3Q FY2026 revenue was RM302 million, down 51.7% year-on-year and 41.4% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM2.3 million, down 95.4% year-on-year and 77.9% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 0.8% versus 2.1% in the prior quarter.
